ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field with distinct high-intensity (white) linear pixel groupings; approximate 85:15 ratio of dark to light surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white linear clusters distributed across the medial and lateral zones of both lobes; dense concentrations of parallel lines oriented vertically on a black background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a steep pixel angle and high bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude serrations; irregular jagged peaks and deep valleys continuous across the trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve fitted to the trailing edge, sweeping upwards towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Rough-textured, high-contrast pixel clusters (white on dark) localized at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe, consistent with biological encrustation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of distinct, unaligned parallel linear pixel groups (rake marks) covering approximately 50% of the visible surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive dental rake markings across both lobes and significant traumatic indentations along the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and dense network of parallel white linear scars creating a distinct high-contrast pattern against the dark fluke pigmentation.
